neighbours.label: ' now' in 'N years from now', a point in the future counted from today, as opposed to the same sentences without it
fire: The real test of this plan comes a decade from now.
Thirty years from now, the river will be gone.
Two or three years from now, I hope to retire.
A hundred years from now, nobody will care.
Six months from now, we can talk again.
Ten years from now, this town will look different.
A week from now, the show opens.
Five years from now, what will you be doing?
quiet: The real test of this plan is its cost.
Thirty years ago, the river was clean.
Two or three years ago, I hoped to retire.
A hundred people came, and nobody cared.
Six months later, we talked again.
Ten miles from here, this town looks different.
A week ago, the show closed.
Where do you live, and what are you doing?

notes: Past-time frames ('When you were inside me') stayed at 0.01 in probes, though the card has ' When' and ' later'.
